_what: Playability census of every stream the documentation environment's live Xtream Codes account imports into Dispatcharr A. Built by FETCHING each stream and reading its body, not by reading a status code.
_no_credentials: This file deliberately carries NO provider host, username, password or stream URL. A live XC stream URL embeds the account credentials in its path segments (bead msqf7). Streams are identified by provider stream id and name only; the environment holds the credentials, the repo never does.

_method.tier1_resolves: final HTTP status after redirects — answers 'does the address resolve', NOT 'does video play'
_method.tier2_plays: read the first 65536 bytes of the body and require MPEG-TS framing (0x47 sync byte at 188-byte stride) — this is the verdict recorded below
_method.tier3_decodes: ffprobe; used to VALIDATE tier 2 on a sample, not to produce these rows
_method.never_HEAD: the provider answers 404 to HEAD on URLs that answer 200 to GET (measured). Never probe with HEAD.
_method.range_ignored: the provider ignores the Range header — 'curl -r 0-0' returns 200 and then streams continuously (8.8 MB in 20 s, measured). Cap bytes and time client-side.
_method.pacing: the account allows 3 concurrent connections. This census was taken strictly sequentially, one connection at a time.
